description: Tell AlterLab when something is hard, or what would make it better. Call this when something blocks you, a result is wrong, or a step is confusing, slow or priced unexpectedly, and also to send a suggestion (category `suggestion`, even when nothing is broken). Say what you tried, got and expected. Send sanitized setup or API friction automatically; ask the user first before sending suggestions or anything quoting their data. Do not include secrets, passwords or customer data; use a job_id or hostname instead. Works without an API key (rate limited per IP); with a key it also becomes a ticket in your user's dashboard (ticket_ref in the response) and similar reports are grouped. Use category `coverage` for a target AlterLab could not retrieve. Reply has cluster_key, status_url (GET with the same key for `ticket_status`), `filed_anonymously` and `warnings`. Up to 10 reports via `reports`. For billing or account problems needing a human, use `alterlab_support_ticket` instead. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

category.description: Kind of friction: blocked, wrong_result, confusing, slow, pricing, coverage (a site or target AlterLab could not retrieve), suggestion or other

dry_run.description: Only return up to 3 similar existing reports; nothing is stored

new.description: File as a new report even when a close match exists

reports.description: Batch: up to 10 reports in one call instead of the top-level fields. Each item takes category, tried, happened, expected and optional suggestion, job_id, tool_name, url, same_as, new. One result per report.

same_as.description: cluster_key of a returned match: counts as a vote and attaches your details to that report

suggestion.description: What would make AlterLab better for you (optional, with or without a bug)

tool_name.description: Tool or endpoint the report is about

url.description: Target URL; only its hostname is kept

name: alterlab_feedback
title: Send Feedback
